notes: PrefLib file 00020-00000003.toi (dataset 00020, 'pierce'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 350 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.
party_source: Wikipedia, "2008 Pierce County Executive election" (McCarthy and Goings Democratic, Bunney Republican); Federal Way Mirror, "Power pursuit shakes up Pierce Co. politics", 16 Sep 2008 (https://www.federalwaymirror.com/2008/09/16/power-pursuit-shakes-up-pierce-co-politics/): Lonergan, denied the Republican label, chose "the Executive Excellence Party" as his ballot label.

label_sources.official_winners: Wikipedia, "2008 Pierce County Executive election" (cites the county's RCV results table of 25 Nov 2008).
label_sources.max_ranks: Pierce County used a 3-rank ballot for its 2008 and 2009 ranked-choice races (county sample ballot; every ballot in the file has 3 or fewer ranks).
